title: chore(objectui): move the console pin to f96f771140f1, carrying objectstack-ai/objectui#12453 and objectstack-ai/objectui#12519
body:
Fixes #23720
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `1f23d5b070fa` to `f96f771140f1`, objectui `main` at `f96f771140f1ba488245e0d0d3e7420d720bff9a`. That commit carries `2a69285` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12453, the Studio read-only posture, the epic's last design child) and `73a3eb2` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12519, navigation edit mode keeps the 240 px rail), and every other commit the card lists as not in the old pin.

It is one bump, through `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, and not a rider on another PR.

**Tier:** no governed surface. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-23720-console-pin-hop` reads 0 of 4 paths on the register (exit 0). Size: 4 files, +47 / −6 (53 changed lines, under the 3000 human-merge line).

## The hop: 31 objectui commits, 267 paths, all on objectui `main`

- REST `compare` `1f23d5b070fa...f96f771140f1`: `ahead_by` 31, `behind_by` 0, `total_commits` 31, 267 files.
- In the sibling checkout (not shallow: `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` answers `false`), `git merge-base --is-ancestor X f96f771140f1` exits 0 for `2a69285` and for `73a3eb2`. It also exits 0 for each of the other seven commits the card lists as missing (`a27c1cf`, `b541694`, `a3d14e7`, `5249c24`, `eea0993`, `baab2d6`, `d17952c`), for the old pin, and for `f96f771140f1` against objectui `origin/main`. `2a69285` is 13 commits behind the new pin and `73a3eb2` is 14 behind.
- The negative leg: each of those nine commits against the OLD pin exits 1. Control leg on the same checkout: `1f23d5b070fa~50` against `1f23d5b070fa` exits 0.

### Why `f96f771140f1`

- When the work started (2026-10-15T22:30Z), `f96f771140f1` was objectui `main`'s tip, the commit the dispatch read.
- At that reading every check-run of objectui's required set read `completed: success`, 41 of 41 across its merge-queue and push runs: `Lint` 2, `Type Check` 2, `Test (shard N/16)` 32, `Build & E2E` 2, `Build Docs` 2, `Changeset Declaration` 1. objectui's `main` ruleset (`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main`) also requires `Test` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, and both read success. The only run still going was `Test (coverage shard 2/8)`, which is not in the required set.
- Re-read at 23:05Z, before opening this PR: objectui `main` had moved 4 commits, to `3e09c1e8d`, whose required set was still running (32 success, 11 in progress). The 4 are `7066dae53` (a docs move), `830eb1f2d` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12522), `f23eb01cb` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12514) and `3e09c1e8d` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12510). The card's "Not this card's" section names those cards as riding a later hop and says this one does not wait for them, so this PR keeps the pin read at dispatch time and does not chase the tip.

## Acceptance readings, at the new pin

### (a) The built console bundle carries the read-only link, and not the retired key

**Source, at objectui `f96f771140f1`.** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` declares `'engine.studio.pkg.readonlyLink': 'Read-only · Customize with an overlay'` (line 3034, and the zh-CN entry at line 6318). `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:526` renders it. `git grep engine.studio.designer.hintReadOnly` finds nothing under `packages` or `apps` at the new pin. At the old pin it finds 5 hits: the two i18n entries, the `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx:806` call site and two test lines.

**Built bundle.** `scripts/build-console.sh` built objectui at the pin into `.cache/objectui-f96f771140f1/`, and its dist was copied to `packages/console/dist/` (3449 files, 3434 under `assets/`). A literal-string grep (`grep -rlF`) over every file:

- `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyLink`: 2 assets. In `assets/studioBuilder-BUpNsRQw.js` it is the link's call site, `` Z(`engine.studio.pkg.readonlyLink`,n) ``, right after its `Layers` icon. In `assets/i18n-Ba_I5RJO.js` it is the table entry, 2 occurrences (en and zh-CN).
- `Read-only · Customize with an overlay`: 1 asset, `assets/i18n-Ba_I5RJO.js`.
- **The control.** The retired key `engine.studio.designer.hintReadOnly` appears in 0 of the 3449 files.
- **Positive control for that zero.** `engine.studio.designer.toolbarHint` is the sibling key the retired one was rendered beside (`ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`, same i18n table). It appears in the same two assets, `studioBuilder-BUpNsRQw.js` and `i18n-Ba_I5RJO.js`, so the grep can see that table and that component.

On the smoke boot below, the served `/_console/assets/i18n-Ba_I5RJO.js` and `/_console/assets/studioBuilder-BUpNsRQw.js` are byte-identical to the dist copies (`cmp` exit 0 each). They give the same readings: 1 English string, 1 key at the call site, 0 retired keys.

### (b) A smoke boot serves `/_console/.objectui-sha` at the new pin

`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 47321` from this worktree, with the `pnpm` PID recorded:

- `GET /api/v1/health` answered 200 (`status: ok`, version `18.0.0-next.1`).
- `GET /_console/` answered 200 (18552 bytes), and its entry `assets/index-CYwFWDSL.js` answered 200 (283056 bytes).
- The served `/_console/.objectui-sha` reads `f96f771140f1ba488245e0d0d3e7420d720bff9a` (200).

I stopped the server by its listening PID (3900) and the recorded `pnpm` PID (3798). Every PID in its process tree was gone afterwards, and `lsof -ti tcp:47321` found nothing.

**No live browser run.** (a) is a source and bundle reading. A browser pass on a read-only package was not part of the card's acceptance and was not done.

## Artefacts that travel with the pin

- **Console changeset** `.changeset/console-f96f771140f1.md`, from `scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit f96f771140f1…`.
  - `@objectstack/console` **minor**, the level the script derived: the highest level objectui declared over the range.
  - The digest walked the range completely: 31 releasing changesets across 31 non-merge commits, 0 breaking (0 declared `major`, 0 annotated), 0 release-nothing, 0 commits without a changeset.
  - **No ADR-0087 marker.** The range declares nothing breaking, so the changeset is not breaking and owes no disposition. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` reads "this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (1 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)". This differs from the previous hop, whose range carried five declared-breaking entries.
- **SDUI manifest.** `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` over `.cache/objectui-f96f771140f1/apps/console` wrote 107 components. `sdui.manifest.json` is **byte-identical** (sha256 `370153544e9b…`, unchanged), so no component, input or accept set moved. Only its provenance record `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` moves (`objectuiSha` and `modulesRoot`). The unchanged manifest is also why `Clause-②: no` holds on the one shipped file this repository adds to the console dist.
- **Lockstep record.** `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-records `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at `f96f771140f1`. It ran with `OBJECTUI_ROOT` set to the pin's build worktree, so the shared objectui checkout's HEAD was never moved. Across the hop, objectui's `packages/sdui-parser` did not change at all (`git diff --stat` is empty). The grammar blob `0131f27cf86d` and the predicate blob `76c18fb95d1f` are unchanged, and `check:sdui-lockstep` passes (214 grammar lines, 25 codes, the predicate). **No parser port is owed.**

## Console Pin Gate steps, run locally

The `Console Pin Gate` is a `main` full-battery job that is skipped on PRs. This is its local equivalent:

1. Client closure: `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/client --filter=@objectstack/sdui-parser --filter=@objectstack/spec` (34 tasks, 34 successful).
2. `scripts/build-console.sh` at the new pin, under the verify lock. It reported:
   - bundle canary `import/jobs` present;
   - exactly one zod version literal (`{major:4,minor:6,patch:5}`, 2252 `assets/*.js` read);
   - "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it";
   - dist ready, 64496 KB, from objectui@f96f771140f1.

   That run came before the manifest regeneration, but the regenerated manifest is byte-identical, so the dist ships the same bytes either way.
3. `pnpm check:console-sha` ("Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@f96f771140f1)") and `pnpm check:console-injection` (self-test 67 assertions, then the injected-spec reading): both exit 0, inside the gate run below.

## Verification, at `b1a8a6bcf`

- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths, from merge base `9bb93706f`) derived 69 commands. Each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. `--ran` reports "69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
  - One first exited 3 (prerequisite not met) and was re-run green at the same head: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed a full `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=!@objectstack/docs` (75 tasks, 75 successful). It then read 110 entry points across 68 packages.
  - Named here: `check-sdui-manifest` (sha256 `370153544e9b…`, 107 components, recorded at the live pin) and its self-test (13 cases), `check:sdui-lockstep`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` ("This diff introduces no `major` bump"), `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check:console-sha` and `check:console-injection`.
- **The package this diff touches.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/sdui-parser exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 14 files, 225 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/sdui-parser typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`): exit 0. The lockstep record is not in that package's `files[]` and no test of it reads the file. These ran as a regression check, not as owed coverage.
- **Not merged with `main` before opening.** `main` moved 4 commits (`9bb93706f` to `d0c09e47c`) while this ran. None of them touches any of this PR's 4 paths. 29 of the 45 paths they touch are under `packages/spec/src`, so a merge would make the locally built console dist's spec-injection reading stale and would need a second console build to re-read it. CI reads this PR at its merge ref, and the queue rebuilds it onto `main`.
- **NOT MEASURED: repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the `Type Check` lanes and the full test farm.** Reason: they are CI-owned runs, and this diff adds no TypeScript.

## Acceptance notes

- **Liveness: no verdict this hop makes stale was found.** The method: the leaf key of each of the 139 non-`live` rows in `packages/spec/liveness/*.json`, grepped as a word over the range's 3610 added lines of non-test objectui source under `packages` and `apps`. The only hits were `pageName`, a local route variable, and `bordered`, in a comment. Neither reads the ledger's `view.list` keys.
  - The rows the previous hop made stale (`page.print`, `translation.flows.successMessage` and `errorMessage`) are still `planned`, and the open family card #23710 carries them. This PR does not change them.
- PR #23708 (`domain:spec` seat 2), which plans a later pin move, touches none of `.objectui-sha`, the manifest pair, the lockstep record or a console changeset: 29 files read at 23:05Z.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12453 and objectstack-ai/objectui#12519 are not cards in this repository. This PR carries their objectui changes into the shipped console and leaves the objectui cards as they are.
